title: A shared random tape does not need a good event at every prefix
statement: Add-one Bernoulli qhat=(K+1)/(N+2) with independent ideal conditional batch per fixed query gives averaged trace error<=2sqrt(m[log((N+2)/(N+1))+zeta_b log(N+2)]). Forward-KL chain avoids a simultaneously good tape event across exponential counterfactual prefixes; a common finite random tape can be reused coherently across them. m=2n,N=O(m/eps^2),with numerical/gate budgets and finite sample-generation resources. Reversible categorical/sorting-network computation and gates are paid,no QRAM oracle. Indicative positive cost Cacq+mn Cstep[Q+m/eps^2],signed adds centers/rejection. This is a quantum-gate construction,not quantum execution. Global importance second moment does not earn cheap conditional prediction; rare-atom plugin KL~log N/N obstruction retained.

Conditional independence between sites, not between times within a site, makes the trace sum `p M delta=p beta`. This removes time-mesh size from the negative rejection exponent while still charging vector dimension, sampling and arithmetic. A finite sampled center and the correctly shifted positive normalizer supply the construction; an optimal-center oracle is not assumed.
